title: Detailed bell
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow halo behind bell -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="38" ry="40" fill="#1a2a3a" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Bell body - main dome -->
  <path d="M50 15 C32 15 22 30 22 48 C22 62 24 70 26 76 L74 76 C76 70 78 62 78 48 C78 30 68 15 50 15 Z" fill="#e8c84a"/>

  <!-- Highlight on left side of dome -->
  <path d="M50 18 C36 18 26 32 26 48 C26 60 27 67 29 72 L36 72 C35 66 34 56 35 44 C36 32 42 21 50 18 Z" fill="#f5e08a" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Darker shade on right side -->
  <path d="M50 18 C64 18 74 32 74 48 C74 60 73 67 71 72 L64 72 C65 66 66 56 65 44 C64 32 58 21 50 18 Z" fill="#c8a832" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Horizontal band near top -->
  <rect x="30" y="22" width="40" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#d4a820"/>
  <rect x="30" y="22" width="40" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#f0d060" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Middle decorative band -->
  <path d="M24 44 Q50 40 76 44 L76 48 Q50 44 24 48 Z" fill="#b89020"/>

  <!-- Lower rim band -->
  <path d="M26 74 Q50 70 74 74 L74 78 Q50 74 26 78 Z" fill="#d4a820"/>
  <rect x="25" y="76" width="50" height="4" rx="2" fill="#b89020"/>

  <!-- Bottom lip -->
  <path d="M24 78 Q50 82 76 78 L76 82 Q50 86 24 82 Z" fill="#c8a030"/>

  <!-- Clapper -->
  <line x1="50" y1="78" x2="50" y2="88" stroke="#8a7020" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="91" r="4" fill="#a08028"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="#d4b848" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Top handle/loop -->
  <path d="M44 15 Q44 6 50 6 Q56 6 56 15" fill="none" stroke="#d4a820" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M45 15 Q45 8 50 8 Q55 8 55 15" fill="none" stroke="#f0d060" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Top knob -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="6" r="3" fill="#e8c84a"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="5" r="1" fill="#f5e08a" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Decorative dots on bell body -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="#c8a030"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="53" r="2.5" fill="#c8a030"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="#c8a030"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="62" r="2" fill="#c8a030"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="62" r="2" fill="#c8a030"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="68" r="2.5" fill="#c8a030"/>

  <!-- Small dots highlight -->
  <circle cx="37.5" cy="54.5" r="1" fill="#f0d060" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="49.5" cy="52.5" r="1" fill="#f0d060" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="61.5" cy="54.5" r="1" fill="#f0d060" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="49.5" cy="67.5" r="1" fill="#f0d060" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Vertical decorative lines -->
  <path d="M35 30 L34 72" stroke="#d4a820" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M65 30 L66 72" stroke="#d4a820" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M50 28 L50 72" stroke="#d4a820" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- Sparkle/shine -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="32" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#f8f0c0" opacity="0.45" transform="rotate(-15 36 32)"/>
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="45" rx="1.5" ry="3" fill="#f8f0c0" opacity="0.3" transform="rotate(-10 34 45)"/>
</svg>
